title: Chilli con carne
summary: A slow-simmered chilli with kidney beans and smoked paprika, served over rice.

variations.label: Dark chocolate
variations.d: Adds depth and rounds off the heat.

variations.label: Dark beer
variations.d: Replaces half the stock for a malty sauce.

variations.label: Cinnamon
variations.d: A warm note in the background.

methods.label: The chilli
methods.q: How do you want to simmer the chilli?

options.d: Simmer gently, stirring now and then.
Brown first, then leave it on low.

methods.label: Rice
methods.q: How do you want to cook the rice?

options.d: Switch it on and forget it.

steps.b: Finely chop the {on:onions}, dice the {pe:red pepper} and crush the {ga:garlic}. Keep them in separate piles.
Stir the {cu:cumin}, {pa:smoked paprika}, {ch:chilli flakes} and {or:oregano} together in a small bowl.
Stir the {cu:cumin}, {pa:smoked paprika}, {ch:chilli flakes}, {or:oregano} and {cn:cinnamon} together in a small bowl.
Tip the {kb:kidney beans} into a sieve and rinse under cold water.
Roughly chop the {dc:dark chocolate} so it melts evenly later.
Rinse the {ri:rice} in a sieve until the water runs clear, then leave it to drain.
Heat the {oi:olive oil} in a large pot over a medium heat. Add the {on:onions} and {pe:pepper} and cook until soft. Add the {ga:garlic} for the last minute.
Turn up the heat, add the {mb:beef mince} and break it up with a spoon until browned all over.
Add the {mp:plant-based mince} and break it up with a spoon until lightly browned.
Stir in the spice mix and the {tp:tomato purée}. Cook for a minute until fragrant.
Pour in the {to:chopped tomatoes} and {st:stock}, then add the {kb:kidney beans}. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Pour in the {be:dark beer} and let it bubble for 2 minutes. Add the {to:chopped tomatoes}, {st:stock} and {kb:kidney beans}, then bring to a simmer.
Partly cover and simmer gently for an hour, stirring now and then. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Cover the pot with a lid and move it to the oven at 150°C. Stir once halfway through.
Transfer everything to the slow cooker, cover and cook on low for 6 hours.
Put the {ri:rice} in a pot with the {wa:water} and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave to rest off the heat for 6.
Put the {ri:rice} and {wa:water} in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cover loosely and cook on full power for 10 minutes, then let it stand for 2.
Add the {ri:rice} and {wa:water} to the rice cooker, close the lid and switch it on. It keeps warm until you serve.
Stir the {dc:chocolate} into the chilli until melted. Taste, season with salt and serve over the rice with {cr:soured cream} and {co:coriander}.
Taste and season with salt. Serve over the rice with {cr:soured cream} and {co:coriander}.

title: Thai green curry
summary: Green curry paste and coconut milk with crisp green beans and jasmine rice.

variations.label: Thai basil
variations.d: Aniseed freshness stirred in at the end.

methods.label: Rice
methods.q: How do you want to cook the jasmine rice?

options.d: Switch it on and forget it.

steps.b: Cut the {ck:chicken thighs} into bite-sized pieces.
Wrap the {tf:tofu} in kitchen paper, weigh it down for 10 minutes, then cut into cubes.
Trim the {gb:green beans} and cut them in half.
Rinse the {ri:jasmine rice} until the water runs clear.
Put the {ri:rice} in a pot with the {wa:water} and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then leave to rest off the heat for 6.
Put the {ri:rice} and {wa:water} in a large microwave-safe bowl. Cover loosely and cook on full power for 10 minutes, then let it stand for 2.
Add the {ri:rice} and {wa:water} to the rice cooker, close the lid and switch it on. It keeps warm until you serve.
Spoon the thick cream from the top of the {cm:coconut milk} into a wok. Fry the {cp:curry paste} in it until fragrant.
Add the {ck:chicken} and stir to coat in the paste. Cook until no longer pink on the outside.
Add the {tf:tofu} and fry, turning gently, until golden on most sides.
Pour in the rest of the {cm:coconut milk}, add the {gb:green beans} and simmer until just tender.
Pour in the rest of the {cm:coconut milk}, add the {gb:green beans} and {bs:bamboo shoots} and simmer until just tender.
Season with the {fs:fish sauce} and a squeeze of {li:lime}. Serve with the rice.
Season with the {ss:soy sauce} and a squeeze of {li:lime}. Serve with the rice.
Take the wok off the heat and stir through the {tb:Thai basil}.

title: Tagliatelle with shallot cream
summary: A quick weeknight pasta with a silky shallot and parmesan sauce.

options.d: Easy to keep in the cupboard.

steps.b: Peel and finely chop the {t3:shallot}.
Finely grate the {t5:parmesan} and chop the {t6:parsley}.
Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil.
Melt half the {t2:butter} in a wide pan over a low heat. Cook the {t3:shallot} until soft, then pour in the {t4:cream} and simmer gently.
Add the {t1:tagliatelle} to the boiling water and cook until just tender. Keep a cup of the cooking water.
Drop the {t1:fresh tagliatelle} into the boiling water and cook for 2–3 minutes. Keep a cup of the cooking water.
Toss the pasta into the sauce with the rest of the {t2:butter} and the {t5:parmesan}. Loosen with pasta water and finish with the {t6:parsley}.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce, finished with feta.

variations.label: Harissa
variations.d: Swaps the paprika smoke for chilli warmth.

methods.label: The eggs
methods.q: How do you want to cook the eggs?

steps.b: Thinly slice the {s1:onion} and {s2:peppers}, and crush the {s3:garlic}.
Cook the {s1:onion} and {s2:peppers} in a little oil until soft. Add the {s3:garlic} and {s5:paprika} for the last minute.
Pour in the {s4:tomatoes}, season and simmer until thick.
Stir in the {hr:harissa}, pour in the {s4:tomatoes}, season and simmer until thick.
Make four hollows and crack in the {s6:eggs}. Cover and cook until the whites are set. Crumble over the {s7:feta}.
Make four hollows, crack in the {s6:eggs} and bake at 200°C until the whites are set. Crumble over the {s7:feta}.

title: Roast carrots with tahini
summary: Sweet roasted carrots with cumin, a lemony tahini dressing and a little honey.

methods.label: The carrots
methods.q: How do you want to roast them?

steps.b: Halve the {c1:carrots} lengthways and toss with the {c2:olive oil} and {c3:cumin seeds}.
Whisk the {c4:tahini} with the {c5:lemon juice}, a pinch of salt and enough cold water to make it pourable.
Spread the {c1:carrots} on a tray and roast at 220°C until caramelised.
Air-fry the {c1:carrots} at 200°C, shaking the basket halfway.
Spoon the dressing over the warm carrots and drizzle with the {c6:honey}.
